text:
Ana P: Kickoff for APAC-2 marketplace launch — coordination thread. Goal: confirm quotas, HW allocation, SI integration window, and announcement gating. Target go-live 2026-07-15. Need owners for each action and clear fallbacks.

Jonah C: Numbers quick take — steady-state estimate ~900 req/s (roughly 120k tokens/min). Requesting 8x A100-equivalent reserved for initial commit. If partner can't reserve, we can rely on burst capacity but unit cost goes up ~35%.

Mira G: SI/integration checklist (high level): 1) staging VPC + test KMS key 2) perf runs (p95 latency <120ms) 3) canary rollout @10% 4) eval run against core prompt set. Uploaded test prompts to partner share. See `staging/README` and `tests/canary.yml`.

Kevin L: Looping in SI PM (Arjun) — he confirmed a 3-week integration window starting 2026-06-01. SI can staff for infra + app wiring but needs quota + KMS access windows confirmed first. I'll send calendar invite Wed 10am SGT.

Clarisa: Legal note — joint announcement embargo until partner marketing signs off and SOC2 addendum executed. Addendum typically 7-10 business days. Also need clarification: will any customer data transit partner infra? If yes, we need data residency clauses.

Ana P: Action items I own: draft partner comms + announcement timeline. Jonah — you own quota ticket. Kevin — lock SI schedule. Mira — publish staging checklist and canary scripts. Clarisa — start addendum draft. ETA for greenlight: 2026-06-10. 

deploy-bot: created partners ticket #A-4721 (assignee: Jonah C). ETA auto: 5d. :white_check_mark:

Jonah C: Ticket #A-4721 updated: partner asked for traffic matrix + peak token caps. Sent sample traffic matrix (attached). Partner requested clarification on long-seq behavior and cache strategy.

Mira G: For long sequences: we'll run quantized variant for evals and enable prefix/KV cache for production canary. Canary update: throttle sequences >4096 to fallback path. Will push `scripts/canary.sh` update later today.

Kevin L: SI kickoff confirmed: Wed 2026-05-26 10:00 SGT. Invite + agenda posted — agenda = infra provisioning, KMS handoff window, test cases, SLA targets.

Ana P: Contingency if quota delayed >7 days: soft-launch with model fallbacks + route majority traffic to APAC-1 + aggressive caching. Communicate contingency to partner so they're not surprised.

Clarisa: Draft addendum uploaded: `legal/APAC2_addendum_v0.1.docx`. Key ask: 90-day data deletion SLA, and explicit statement that Redwood retains data control (partner only provides infra). Sent to partner legal for review.

Jonah C: Partner replied — provisional quota of 6x A100 available immediately, but KMS access is blocked until SOC2 addendum is finalized. They can provide burst nodes for short-term peaks but declined to commit to reserved SKUs without the addendum.

Mira G: Ok — adjust canary: use burst nodes + enable prefix cache + reduce max context for canary to 2048. Updating test plan and will re-run perf suite.

Kevin L: SI can proceed with integration work that doesn't require KMS. We'll sequence tasks so cryptographic handoffs happen late in the window.

Ana P: Updated timeline: if addendum sign-off by 2026-06-08 -> proceed as planned. If later, soft-launch 2026-07-01 with contingency. Please update status in thread by EOD Friday.

Jonah C: FYI — partner requested a short technical doc explaining our expected token distribution and caching behavior. I uploaded `partner/traffic-matrix.csv` and pinged their infra lead.

Mira G: Small note: when using burst nodes we should enable smaller batch sizes to keep latency SLOs. I'll add batch tuning to the canary runbook.

Clarisa: Partner legal acked receipt of addendum. They expect internal review ~5 business days. I'll escalate on our side if we don't see a redline by next Tue.

Ana P: Thanks all. Next sync: Tue standup + Kevin's SI kickoff Wed. I'll compile a one-pager for partner marketing once we have provisional quotas + addendum progress. :rocket:

deploy-bot: partners ticket #A-4721 status changed to `waiting-on-partner` (timestamp 1794500450).

Jonah C: Partner follow-up: provisional quota confirmed in writing, KMS still blocked until addendum. They're open to a private key escrow flow for testing.

Mira G: Escrow flow works for staging tests. For production we need partner KMS or bring-your-own-key option. Putting options in the runbook.

Kevin L: SI asked for final acceptance criteria: 1) perf p95 <120ms on reserved nodes (or burst with <150ms), 2) canary <1% error rate, 3) rollout rollback <15min. Confirming these are OK.

Ana P: Confirmed. I'll add to the partner SOW and comms. If anything changes, update thread.

(ends)
